subject: planner: index pruning using existing infra (#64999)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff (first-parent) focusing on planner/sessionctx/statistics behavior. Index pruning is introduced via `CollectPredicateColumnsPoint` by collecting per-DataSource `InterestingColumns` (`pkg/planner/core/rule/collect_column_stats_usage.go`) and pruning `AllPossibleAccessPaths`/`PossibleAccessPaths` (`pkg/planner/core/rule/rule_collect_plan_stats.go`, `pkg/planner/core/rule/rule_prune_indexes.go`) gated by new sysvar `tidb_opt_index_prune_threshold` (default 20, min -1) (`pkg/sessionctx/vardef/tidb_vars.go`, `pkg/sessionctx/variable/sysvar.go`). Safety/compat checks look sound for correctness: table paths are always kept; forced index hints bypass pruning; IndexMerge with explicitly named indexes is preserved; common-handle primary index IDs are preserved for stats loading; no Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, data consistency, or session behavior within the touched areas.
